sentences: A cellular automaton's limit set contains every configuration that can appear after arbitrarily many update steps.
This project asks which subshifts can arise as such limit sets.
The characterization concerns all possible initial configurations, including exceptional behaviors of negligible probability.
The source's positive result instead addresses measure-based limit sets under random initial conditions and therefore answers a different question.
An ordinary limit-set characterization would describe the full range of persistent global behavior that can emerge from a finite local update rule.
